headline: NCLT Declares Former Videocon Promoter Venugopal Dhoot Bankrupt Over ₹12,668-Cr Default
summary: The NCLT Mumbai bench declared former Videocon promoter Venugopal Dhoot bankrupt after accepting the State Bank of India's petition over loan defaults totaling ₹12,668 crore.
why: High-profile corporate insolvency resolutions and personal bankruptcies highlight ongoing efforts to recover distressed assets and enforce loan defaults in the banking sector.

impacts.name: State Bank of India
impacts.why: Acceptance of the bankruptcy petition advances legal recovery proceedings for unpaid loans owed to the bank.
